reply.text:
This message mentions a body part that hurts ("shoulder's achy"), but the athlete is asking for a training change, not describing damage or asking what is wrong. Per the soreness rule, that is a patch: set the matching limitation and say nothing about the shoulder itself. "Anything above the head" maps to no_overhead, and the shoulder ache maps to shoulders.

{"route": "patch", "say": "Got it, no overhead work and we'll keep the shoulders out of the hard pressing.", "patch": {"limitations": ["shoulders", "no_overhead"]}}
